name: Sutjeska in a day
description_md:
Sutjeska in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city's main sights. This walk is anchored in Sutjeska, BA.

The route features 6 sightseeing stops. There are 12.6 km of walking between stops. The full day takes about 7.5 hours, with the visit time at each stop included.
